# Solutions

## CSV import crashes with MemoryError on large files
- **Symptoms:** MemoryError importing files over ~2GB
- **Context:** src/import/loader.py
- **What didn't work:** raising container memory — FAILED, biggest files still crash
- **Solution:** chunked reads (chunksize=50000) with incremental aggregation
- **Why it works:** peak memory bounded by chunk size, not file size
- **Verified:** test_import_large.py green on 3.1GB fixture
- **Date:** 2026-07-01
